_comment: Where the island wildlife comes from (WRWildlife). Each region is a side of the island (volcanic: X < 0) and an elevation band of the walk map (Data/island_walk.json bands), optionally cut down to an area box [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in metres. target: how many animals it should have (times the world's creature numbers). creatures: what lives there, each with a weight: the chance a new pack is of that kind (a kind only starts where it can live: its own side and band, clear of the camps). A new world fills every region; then every wildlife.spawnCheckSeconds a region short of its target gets up to wildlife.spawnPacksPerCheck new packs, away from players and buildings (tuning.json wildlife). Pack sizes are creatures.json pack. packRadius (cm): how far a new pack of that kind is spread. raiders: the hunters that raid a land claim in the region (WRRaids, tuning.json raid), each with a weight; a raid's kinds are rolled by weight until its points are spent. placeholder
